pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO castle stay beside LEGOLAND Billund, with themed rooms, in-room treasure hunts and an outdoor playground.

Stay and planning

The hotel opened with 142 themed rooms on 29 March 2019. Choose the room theme and check occupancy and park-ticket inclusions before booking. Confirm park operating days for a winter visit.

Development

The operator announced a DKK200 million investment in 2017; this is the announced project investment, not an audited final outturn or a nightly rate.

pin.longFormSummary:
A Southern California family lodge with an indoor water park included for registered overnight guests; budget separately for parking and paid attractions.

Stay and planning

The lodge began welcoming guests on 19 February 2016. Water-park access is included with an overnight stay; room occupancy, parking, dining and attractions such as MagiQuest affect the total trip cost. The indoor water park makes this a year-round family option.

Development

Bisnow reported a $250 million hotel-and-water-park project at opening. This is project cost, not a nightly room rate.

pin.longFormSummary:
A compact design hotel near Tate Modern and Borough Market, with rooms for up to two adults and shared lounge space.

Stay and planning

Opened on 4 July 2012, this Bankside hotel prioritises a large bed, compact room and shared living-room areas. The operator describes rooms for two adults; this is a city stay for couples or solo visitors. Oyster identifies competitive pricing, but current rates vary by date. The hotel has no on-site parking.

pin.longFormSummary:
A compact Orchard Road city hotel with a pool and easy access to Orchard MRT; Premium Queen rooms are 14 square metres for up to two guests.

Stay and planning

The owner records operations starting on 1 October 2017. The hotel has 610 rooms. Current Premium Queen rooms are 14 square metres with a maximum of two guests; Premium Triple rooms are also 14 square metres and accommodate up to three. Space is the tradeoff for the Orchard Road location. Compare date-specific room rates, taxes and breakfast inclusions.

Value positioning

Forbes Vetted selected YOTEL Singapore as its best-value Singapore hotel in July 2024. This is an editorial recommendation; compare current date-specific rates before booking.
